jobs.description:
Summary
  
  
Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS&T) organization. IS&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS&T makes the impossible feel effortless. G&A Solutions Engineering (GSE) is IS&T's dedicated technology partner for Apple's general and administrative functions — including people, finance, facilities, legal, and security. The team builds and delivers integrated technology solutions that keep these functions running efficiently and securely at global scale. GSE also works closely with business teams to develop custom tools that improve productivity and bring greater automation and consistency to G&A operations across Apple.

Most financial systems record what happened. We are building one that reasons — where AI agents interpret business intent, validate and enrich transactions, route approvals, match documents, and resolve exceptions, with humans in the loop by policy rather than by default. As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build the services that make that possible: the transaction pipeline, the sub-ledger, the orchestration layer, the tool APIs agents call, and the interfaces finance operators use to supervise and correct agent work. You will work across the stack with a backend center of gravity — the majority of your time in distributed services and data, and real ownership of the APIs and operator-facing surfaces that sit on top of them. You will work closely with the platform architect and with Finance, Controllership, and Accounts Payable partners. Correctness matters here in a way it doesn't in most systems: the code you write

**About Neumo**

Neumo builds the cloud software that powers government. More than 4,500 state, local and federal agencies across North America run on our platforms, processing over 900 million transactions and collecting $44 billion in revenue for the communities they serve. When a county records a deed, a family orders a birth certificate, or a business files a local tax return, that transaction often runs through our systems.

That comes with a particular kind of engineering responsibility. Our platforms are systems of record for legally binding documents and public funds. Correctness is not negotiable, downtime has civic consequences, and the data we hold is expected to remain accurate and retrievable for decades.

**Summary**

The Senior Software Engineer designs, builds and maintains features for Neumo’s Records platform (Land Records, Vital Records and Search). County recorders and clerks use it to record deeds, index documents, issue certified birth, death and marriage certificates, and give the public secure access to records that go back generations. Every recorded document has legal weight, so correctness, security and reliability are essential.

Records is a key area of investment for Neumo. We are evolving it from a tightly coupled, manually configured platform that depends on specific peripherals into a best-in-class product that meets customers where they are. Positioned between the Software Engineer and Staff Engineer roles, the Senior Software Engineer owns features from design through production and makes sound technical decisions within their area. They raise code quality on the team and help newer engineers grow. This role requires strong skills in .NET, SQL Server and cloud technologies, plus the judgment to work effectively in Neumo’s AI-assisted, agentic delivery model.

The Senior Software Engineer reports to a Software Engineering Manager on the Records platform.
